hypothesis: Confirmatory refinement of the exp-20260601-007 incidental lead: a long-only top-quintile of 5-day-formation winners, held 10 trading days (skip-day), earns positive forward return IN EXCESS of the broad-universe equal-weight mean (long-only alpha), net of one round-trip cost (0.35pct), in a majority of the canonical 3 windows. The decisive NEW test is incrementality over core momentum: within ret20 (core-momentum proxy) quintile bands, the 5d-formation top-minus-bottom forward spread must survive (double-sort), otherwise the short-formation continuation is just the same momentum the core already trades. f5/h10 cell selection is inherited from exp-20260601-007 and carries its multiple-testing debt, so the per-day t-stat is reported but is NOT treated as independent confirmation; the ret20 double-sort is the load-bearing evidence.

prediction.confidence_reason: 5d and 20d momentum are correlated, so the short-formation top-quintile continuation likely partially collapses after controlling for ret20; modest odds a short-horizon-specific residual survives the double-sort AND clears cost on a majority of windows.
